title: MCP Schema-Defined Tool
description: A saved-query tool exposed on the MCP server, defined per collection. Stored as a deck item — the deck key matches the tool's id.
formgrid:
id id
description description
---Query---
params params
filters filters
---Result Shape---
limit offset
format format
sort sort
include include
exclude exclude

id.label: Tool ID
id.help: Snake_case identifier AI clients use to call this tool. Becomes the wire-level tool name when registered.

description.label: Description
description.help: What this tool returns. Shown to AI agents in tools/list — write for AI consumption, not LLM instructions.

params.label: Params
params.help: Typed caller parameters as JSON. See the docs for the param shape.

filters.label: Filters
filters.help: Field-name → {value, operator} map as JSON. Filter values may reference {{params.X}} placeholders.

limit.label: Limit
limit.help: Max results per call. Capped at 50.

offset.label: Offset
offset.help: Skip the first N matching results.

include.label: Include
include.help: REST-style include filter — escape hatch for shapes the structured filters object can't express.
